definition: [ מָשָׁה ] verb draw (Arabic cleanse uterus of camel, Aramaic clean, stroke, the face, etc.; מְשָׁא (Talmud) wash the hands; Zinjirli משׂי [ י ] perhaps wash oneself, DHM Sendsch. 60 ); — Qal Perfect suffix מִןהַֿמַּיִם מְשִׁיתִהוּ Exod 2:10 out of the water I drew him (used to explain משֶׁה , but see this below) Hiph`il Imperfect suffix = Qal , figurative יַמְשֵׁנִי מִמַיִם רַבִּים 2Sam 22:17 = Ps 18:7 (subject ׳ י ).
